custom_fields.description: A list of up to 4 custom fields to be displayed on the invoice.

days_until_due.description: Number of days within which a customer must pay invoices generated by this quote. This value will be `null` for quotes where `collection_method=charge_automatically`.

description.description: An arbitrary string attached to the object. Often useful for displaying to users.

footer.description: Footer to be displayed on the invoice.
